description: Defines the QuicBufferedPacketStore class for buffering and managing QUIC packets, including handling of CHLOs, packet expiration, and connection management within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStore
classes.description: Manages buffering of QUIC packets per connection, handles CHLOs, expiration, and delivery of packets.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStore::BufferedPacket
classes.description: Represents a buffered QUIC packet with associated addresses.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStore::BufferedPacketList
classes.description: A list of buffered packets for a connection, with metadata such as creation time and version.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStore::VisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for handling events like packet expiration.

methods.name: EnqueuePacket
methods.description: Adds a packet to the buffer for a specific connection, possibly parsing CHLO.

methods.name: HasBufferedPackets
methods.description: Checks if there are buffered packets for a connection.

methods.name: IngestPacketForTlsChloExtraction
methods.description: Processes a packet for TLS CHLO extraction, returning parsing status and extracted info.

methods.name: DeliverPackets
methods.description: Retrieves and removes buffered packets for a connection.

methods.name: DiscardPackets
methods.description: Discards buffered packets for a specific connection.

methods.name: OnExpirationTimeout
methods.description: Handles expiration of buffered packets based on time.

methods.name: DeliverPacketsForNextConnection
methods.description: Delivers packets for the next connection with CHLO to open.

methods.name: HasChloForConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection has a buffered CHLO.

methods.name: HasChlosBuffered
methods.description: Checks if any CHLOs are buffered.
